headings: 第八章 相对论基础
92. 电动力学定律和相对论原理

paragraphs.expectation: Electrodynamics and optics lead to revision of space and time concepts.
Classical time independent of motion and absolute, dimensions independent of rest or motion and length absolute; no modernization of original wording.
Einstein special relativity as a new theory replacing old classical space/time concepts; preserve bold text.

Maxwell late nineteenth century, electrodynamics laws and whether mechanical relativity extends to electromagnetic phenomena, charges/currents interaction and wave propagation, identical in all inertial reference frames versus uniform straight motion affecting electromagnetic processes.

Must determine whether electrodynamics fundamental principles change when moving between inertial frames or stay invariant like Newton laws; only latter makes application certain; final word fragment remains open.
